quotes.text: Jan 22, 2017: Kellyanne Conway, on *Meet the Press*, offers 'alternative facts' as a defense of the inauguration crowd-size claim.
The Mueller Report Vol. I documented Internet Research Agency operations reaching ~126 million Americans on Facebook in 2016.
Cambridge Analytica drew on personality profiles for ~87 million Facebook users — most without their knowledge — for microtargeted 2016 campaigning.
Between Oct 2017 and Dec 2020, 'Q' posted ~4,953 'drops' on 4chan and 8kun. Identity remains debated; Watkins family suspected.
A 2022 NYT analysis catalogued 400+ Tucker Carlson segments invoking 'replacement' framings between 2018 and 2022.
The Jan 6 Committee documented a coordinated pipeline from the 'Stop the Steal' organizers to the Capitol breach, including 11 White House calls in the preceding 72 hours.
White evangelicals delivered ~81% of their 2016 presidential vote to Trump, the highest evangelical bloc share for any candidate since exit polling began.
At his Twitter peak (early 2021) Trump had ~88 million followers. Reach per tweet routinely exceeded the audience of every cable news show combined.
Alex Jones was ordered to pay $1.4B+ in defamation judgments to Sandy Hook families for years of false 'crisis actor' claims on Infowars.
